name: arrow-expr-test-733bf0507c/arrow-expressions-v.bal
reason: testNillableParameter uses the Elvis expression x ?: "John" and main asserts its fallback result John for nil input. Elvis expressions are not included in the supported expression list; conditional and nil-lifted expressions are separately listed constructs and do not establish support for Elvis fallback semantics. This essential unsupported construct makes the whole case a feature.
unsupported_constructs: Elvis expression (x ?: "John") and its nil-fallback behavior
test_design_notes: The @output John assertion requires execution of the Elvis fallback; supported function signatures alone cannot establish this behavior.
